answer: An attacker running 56 aliases therefore needs 187 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in marble, expire in forge, and ledge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4651 identities would post 1241 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
